problem_statement: Build a brand-new Event Schedule page at the route /calendar on the MatDash Vuetify Free admin template (Vue 3 + Vite + vue-router with createWebHistory, plus Vuetify). The route does not exist yet in baseline (it renders an empty placeholder). Construct the full page from scratch using the site's existing Vuetify design system (v-card/v-btn/v-tabs/v-window/v-list/v-chip/v-avatar/v-progress-linear) and register it as a child of the FullLayout route so it reuses the sidebar/topbar chrome. The page must include: (1) a header card with an 'Event Schedule' title (h3), an intro paragraph beginning 'Plan the week ahead', and an 'Add event' button; (2) a three-card stats strip (Events this week / Team meetings / Deadlines); (3) a v-tabs tabbed schedule with three tabs - Agenda, Meetings, Deadlines - wired to a v-window. The Agenda tab is active on first paint and shows a 'This week's agenda' heading plus a list of events. Clicking the Meetings tab must reveal a 'Scheduled meetings' section (h3) that is NOT visible on the default Agenda view. The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow on mobile.
required_content: Header card with an 'Event Schedule' title (h3), an intro paragraph starting 'Plan the week ahead' (full copy: 'Plan the week ahead and keep the team aligned on meetings and deadlines.'), and an 'Add event' button
Stats strip: three cards showing Events this week (12), Team meetings (5) and Deadlines (3)
A v-tabs tab bar with Agenda / Meetings / Deadlines tab buttons wired to a v-window
Agenda tab (default/active): a 'This week's agenda' heading (h3) + a v-list of weekly events with day avatars, times and category chips
Meetings tab: a 'Scheduled meetings' section (h3, hidden until the Meetings tab is clicked) listing recurring/one-off meetings
Deadlines tab: a 'Project deadlines' section with v-progress-linear bars
Responsive layout (stacks on mobile, sidebar auto-hidden, no horizontal overflow)
design_constraints: Reuse Vuetify components (v-card, v-card-item, v-card-text, v-row, v-col, v-btn, v-tabs, v-tab, v-window, v-window-item, v-list, v-list-item, v-chip, v-avatar, v-progress-linear, v-divider)
Reuse the site's theme colors (primary #635BFF, info, success, warning, error, light* tints) and utility/spacing classes (text-muted, text-h4, py-5, px-6, mb-4)
Register the view inside MainRoutes children so the FullLayout sidebar/topbar chrome is inherited
Use vue-tabler-icons global components (PlusIcon, UsersIcon) for iconography

Match the reference palette so key colors overlap: primary #635BFF (rgb 99,91,255), page/surface backgrounds white #ffffff and light tints #f4f7fb / #fafbfd, muted text slate #69759f, and success tint #e5faf7 (use these existing theme tokens rather than inventing new colors)
author_notes: Scheme A: baseline registers /calendar as an EMPTY top-level route (outside FullLayout, no chrome) so the route renders blank and check A holds; reference implements the full page with a working v-tabs/v-window interaction inside FullLayout; bad renders the same content but with an inert v-btn tab bar and every panel stacked always-visible, so the 'Scheduled meetings' reveal delta never holds (interaction gate fails, DOM/overflow gates still pass -> discriminating on interaction only). Router uses createWebHistory so state_plan paths are plain /calendar. The genuine interaction: clicking the Meetings tab (button[data-tab=meetings], selected via data-attr per gotcha #18l to avoid shell-chrome Calendar/Meetings vocab collisions) switches the v-window and reveals 'Scheduled meetings' (h3) which is display:none in the default Agenda window; bad shows it unconditionally so changed_from cannot hold. Three workspace source trees are md5-distinct. build = vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build, all three exit 0 offline.
